data.title: Bitcoin price recovery narrows odds on higher 2026 targets, prediction market data shows
data.description: Bitcoin was trading at $77,121 on Thursday, having clawed back much of its summer losses in a sharp August rally. The cryptocurrency gained roughly 24% during August alone, rising from around $62,600 at the start of the month to a peak of $80,797 on August 25. That rebound has reshaped...
